cues: After unpacking, she sorted the novels by author and placed each spine outward for easy browsing.
During weekly tidying, he returned borrowed volumes to their usual positions and straightened the uneven rows.
To prevent damage, she laid oversized atlases flat beneath lighter paperbacks on the lowest level.
Visitors scan the titles, pull out a chosen volume, then nudge neighboring books back into line.
Before moving house, they removed every book and wrapped the sturdy wooden frame separately.
After dusting each exposed ledge, he replaced the books in alphabetical order.
